title: Ten Minutes of Life
simplified_paragraphs: 父亲与儿子做游戏：10分钟代表一个人的一生，在这10分钟里，每人从一本书里找"黄金”这个词语，谁找得多谁就赢……游戏开始后，儿子和父亲都找得很努力。9分钟的时候，儿子一共找到了10个，而父亲却只找到了4个。"
爸爸，你输了。”儿子兴奋地说。父亲说："我承认我输了。可是就这么结束了吗？”父亲看了看时间，说：”9分40秒了，10分钟的一生很快就要结束了。虽然你有很多黄金，但是你已经没有时间去享用了，其实时间比黄金更宝贵！”
traditional_paragraphs: 父親與兒子做遊戲：10分鐘代表一個人的一生，在這10分鐘裡，每人從一本書裡找"黃金”這個詞語，誰找得多誰就贏……遊戲開始後，兒子和父親都找得很努力。9分鐘的時候，兒子一共找到了10個，而父親卻只找到了4個。"
爸爸，你輸了。”兒子興奮地說。父親說："我承認我輸了。可是就這麼結束了嗎？”父親看了看時間，說：”9分40秒了，10分鐘的一生很快就要結束了。雖然你有很多黃金，但是你已經沒有時間去享用了，其實時間比黃金更寶貴！”
pinyin_paragraphs: fù qīn yǔ ér zi zuò yóu xì：10 fēn zhōng dài biǎo yī gè rén de yī shēng， zài zhè 10 fēn zhōng lǐ， měi rén cóng yī běn shū lǐ zhǎo " huáng jīn” zhè gè cí yǔ， shéi zhǎo de duō shéi jiù yíng …… yóu xì kāi shǐ hòu， ér zi hé fù qīn dōu zhǎo de hěn nǔ lì。9 fēn zhōng de shí hou， ér zi yī gòng zhǎo dào le 10 gè， ér fù qīn què zhǐ zhǎo dào le 4 gè。"

bà ba， nǐ shū le。” ér zi xīng fèn de shuō。 fù qīn shuō：" wǒ chéng rèn wǒ shū le。 kě shì jiù zhè me jié shù le ma？” fù qīn kàn le kàn shí jiān， shuō：”9 fēn 40 miǎo le，10 fēn zhōng de yī shēng hěn kuài jiù yào jié shù le。 suī rán nǐ yǒu hěn duō huáng jīn， dàn shì nǐ yǐ jīng méi yǒu shí jiān qù xiǎng yòng le， qí shí shí jiān bǐ huáng jīn gèng bǎo guì！”
english_paragraphs: The father and his son played a game: 10 minutes represents a person's life. During these 10 minutes, each person looks for the word "gold" from a book. Whoever finds more will win... After the game started, both the son and the father worked hard to find it. In 9 minutes, the son found a total of 10, but the father only found 4. "

Dad, you lose. The son said excitedly. The father said: "I admit that I lost." But is it over? "My father looked at the time and said," It's 9 minutes and 40 seconds. This 10-minute life will soon be over. Although you have a lot of gold, you have no time to enjoy it. In fact, time is more precious than gold! "
english_full:
The father and his son played a game: 10 minutes represents a person's life. During these 10 minutes, each person looks for the word "gold" from a book. Whoever finds more will win... After the game started, both the son and the father worked hard to find it. In 9 minutes, the son found a total of 10, but the father only found 4. "

Dad, you lose. The son said excitedly. The father said: "I admit that I lost." But is it over? "My father looked at the time and said," It's 9 minutes and 40 seconds. This 10-minute life will soon be over. Although you have a lot of gold, you have no time to enjoy it. In fact, time is more precious than gold! "
